# mySocials

> mySocials is a link-in-bio service: one page with a custom URL (links.itsmatias.com/username) that collects all of a creator's links, with themes, image and video tabs, and click analytics.

## Who it is for

- Creators, freelancers and small businesses who want a single link for their social bios.

## Features

- Custom username URL and a public profile page.
- Dark and light themes with an accent color.
- Tabs for links, image galleries and videos.
- Click analytics per link.
- Instagram import to fill a profile from existing posts.
